    HexCodePoints
    Reads the hex code point notation of Unicode data files and similar code point tables: one code point as hex digits (1F600), a sequence as hex digits separated by whitespace (1F468 200D 1F469), and an inclusive range as two code points joined by two dots (1F3FB..1F3FF).
